target_pattern: Use deber in present for direct obligation and deberia/deberias in conditional for softer suggestions or recommendations, with deber plus infinitive as the core structure.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Using one generic should pattern and missing tone differences.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Spanish uses tense choice in deber to adjust force: present for stronger obligation and conditional for softer advice.
target_pattern_formula: direct obligation: deber in present plus infinitive
self-talk advice frame: yo deberia plus infinitive
add subject when needed because deberia can be ambiguous

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: Debes estudiar mas. -> make it softer advice to tu.
Base: Yo deberia limpiar la casa. -> make it direct obligation.
Base: Deberiamos salir temprano. -> change subject to ellos.
Base: Debo llamar al banco. -> change to softer self-advice.
Base: Deben pagar hoy. -> change to singular el.
Base: Ella deberia descansar. -> change to plural nosotros.
Base: Debes comer algo. -> make it formal usted soft advice.
Base: Ustedes deberian llegar antes. -> make it direct obligation.
Base: Yo deberia hacer cafe. -> change infinitive to sacar la basura.
Base: Debemos terminar ahora. -> change to recommendation and add pronto instead of ahora.
Base: El debe responder hoy. -> change to soft suggestion for tomorrow.
Base: Yo deberia ordenar mi oficina. -> change noun to cuarto.
Base: Deberian reciclar mas. -> change to first person plural recommendation.
Base: Debes salir ya. -> change to negative soft advice not leave yet.
Base: Yo debo levantarme temprano. -> change to softer routine reflection.

contrastive_discrimination.instructions: Choose the better option for the intended meaning.
prompts: Soft advice to a friend. (Debes descansar. vs Deberias descansar.)
Strict instruction from a manager. (Debes enviar el reporte hoy. vs Deberias enviar el reporte hoy.)
Personal reflection not command. (Yo debo organizarme mejor. vs Yo deberia organizarme mejor.)
Gentle recommendation to a team. (Deben reunirse mas seguido. vs Deberian reunirse mas seguido.)
Urgent rule right now. (Debes apagar eso ahora. vs Deberias apagar eso ahora.)
Polite advice to a client. (Usted debe revisar este punto. vs Usted deberia revisar este punto.)
Talking about healthy habits softly. (Debemos comer mejor. vs Deberiamos comer mejor.)
Non-negotiable deadline. (Deben terminar hoy. vs Deberian terminar hoy.)
Suggestion to yourself. (Debo acostarme mas temprano. vs Deberia acostarme mas temprano.)
Softer proposal in a meeting. (Debemos cambiar la estrategia. vs Deberiamos cambiar la estrategia.)

common_errors.mistake: Using present deber for every should meaning
common_errors.why_it_happens: English should seems like one form.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use conditional deberia forms for softer advice.

common_errors.mistake: Using conditional in strict urgent contexts
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use present deber for firm obligation.

common_errors.mistake: Replacing all advice with tengo que
common_errors.correct_spanish: Deberia is often better for personal recommendation tone.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Deberia form overlaps yo el ella usted.

common_errors.correct_spanish: Say deberias estudiar not deberias que estudiar.

common_errors.mistake: Weak wording in high urgency scenarios
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use debe/deben when obligation is immediate.
Usted deberia is respectful and natural.
Automate deberia plus infinitive as a core frame.
